description: Cataclysm x Create Integration is a data pack.

pages.title: Cataclysm x Create
pages.text: **Cataclysm x Create Integration** is a data pack. It replaces Cataclysm's gear recipes with Create ones, so boss loot gets turned into equipment by machines instead of at a normal crafting table.

About 35 items are made by **Sequenced Assembly**: a base item goes through Deployer, Press, Deployer steps with boss materials. A few use Mechanical Crafting. Weapons, armor, shields, smithing templates and summoning Eyes are covered.

pages.title: Mechanical Fusion Anvil
pages.text: Made from an Anvil with Sturdy Sheets, Precision Mechanisms and Redstone Blocks.

pages.title: Example: The Incinerator
pages.text: Starts as a Netherite sword. Check JEI for its Sequenced Assembly.

pages.title: Laser Gatling
pages.text: Starts as a crossbow, uses electron tubes and redstone blocks.

It also adds crushing recipes that recycle Cataclysm gear: black steel tools, Cursium, Ignitium and more go into a Crushing Wheel for nuggets, some ingots and XP nuggets. Read [#](2E5AAC)[Crushing](entry://create_basics/crushing)[#]() and [#](2E5AAC)[Assembly](entry://create_basics/brass_and_assembly)[#]().

The Abyssal Sacrifice, a Cataclysm ritual item, is now a compacting recipe that needs a heated Basin, so a Blaze Burner. See [#](2E5AAC)[Heat](entry://create_basics/heat)[#](). Links: [#](2E5AAC)[Cataclysm](entry://exploration/cataclysm)[#]().
